**Role:** <!-- curator. Every session posts as the same account, so this line is the only
thing that says who is speaking. -->

<!-- Label this issue with the project's own role string, `contributor/<domain>/<project>`
or `curator/<project>`, copied rather than composed: applying a label creates it, so a
misspelling makes a second label nobody filters on. That label is how the session that can
act on this finds it. -->

## What was read

<!-- Paths and lines, and the command whose output is quoted below. A finding nobody can
retrace is a hunch. -->

## What was found

<!-- One claim, stated so it can be disagreed with. Not "the module feels tangled" but
"`render` is exported and called nowhere in the project". -->

## Why it matters

<!-- A rule, a cost, or a defect that has already happened once. If it is none of those, say
so; a preference honestly labelled is easier to weigh than one dressed as a rule. -->

## What it costs to leave it

<!-- Honestly. "Little today, more at scale" is a real answer and a better one than
manufactured urgency. -->

## What is not being asked

<!-- The scope this does not extend to, so a small finding does not read as a demand to
redesign. -->
